patterns: APPSC asks direct items: India's HDI category (Medium, 0.685), India's rank in a named HDR (119 in 2010, 134 in 2023-24), what HDI does NOT include (assets, environment, nutrition).
Origin facts recur across PSCs: UNDP, 1990, Mahbub ul Haq; HPI 1997 replaced by MPI 2010; first state HDR Madhya Pradesh.
APPSC Group-1 uses long multi-statement items on IHDI/GDI/PHDI conceptual traps (IHDI = HDI when no inequality; GDI < 1 favours men).
State angle: Kerala tops state HDI; Bihar lowest; AP tilt via MPI headcount comparisons.
App MCQs add many match/A-R items on the capability approach and 2025-26 poverty data, more conceptual than APPSC's rank/category recall.
